title: Zero Coding Skills to Chief Innovation Officer in 3 Years #shorts
description: Jake Hall calls out Milan live on stream — from not knowing how to code to becoming Chief Innovation Officer at an AI risk lab. Jake's own take? Still making YouTube coding videos after 5 years and not planning to stop.  @jaycoolh @Ashe_Oro @hedera
